# When a current line becomes a piece of baseball history

History Match discovers meaningful combinations below a player’s or team’s
actual performance, then checks the same season or rolling window against
verified history. Season-level hitter searches pair daily FanGraphs totals with
Lahman/Retrosheet season history, while rolling and game windows use the
Retrosheet player-game index. Candidates must be scarce by both occurrence
count and season frequency; patterns that recur every year are withheld. Only
producer-reviewed claims appear here.
:::
